summary: Examples of splitext on /etc/make.conf, ansible.cfg, and a path with no extension.
questions: What does splitext return for a file without an extension?

answer_card.title: splitext examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
gobble: "{{ '/etc/make.conf' | splitext }}"   # ['/etc/make', '.conf']
file_n_ext: "{{ 'ansible.cfg' | splitext }}"   # ['ansible', '.cfg']
hoax: "{{ '/etc/hoasdf' | splitext }}"         # ['/etc/hoasdf', '']
```
